name: Create Metallurgy 1.0.1-1.20.1 for Create 6.0.8
changelog:
# Create Metallurgy - v1.0.1

### Additions
- Added Polish localization thanks to CrazyBarkley
- Added Jade compatibility with Ladles #122
- Added CreateHeatJS support #127
- Added crushed ores melting recipes #132
- Added raw ores block melting recipes #132

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed wrong particle texture of rare ladles #111
- Fixed Belt Grinder speed requirement not working properly #120
- Fixed Ladles duplication with the Labeling Station #121
- Fixed Industrial Crucible melting recipe heat update #135
- Fixed gauge attachment advancement

### Gameplay Changes
- Coke recipe is now blasting coal instead of coal ore
- Changed Wolframite/Tungsten items name because of an inconsistency
- Changed block items name because of an inconsistency
- Changed the direction of the belt grinder animation for greater consistency

name: Create Metallurgy 1.0.0-1.20.1 for Create 6.0.8
changelog:
# Create Metallurgy - v1.0.0
![Molten Logistics - Update 1 Part I](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7b9f8c18bd034d631636b1afd8c9c6e53acfd58f.png)
### Additions
- Added Ladles
- Added Ladle Filter item
- Added Labeling Station
- Added Slag blocks
- Added Refractory Mortar Ball
- Added belt processing behaviour to Faucet
- Added Gauge attachment item description
- Added molten fluids water interactions
- Added random Ladle models from the Community Contest (Winners: RestingPhantom, Aaby) special thx for all other participants

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed Casting blocks that become stuck after chunks were unloaded #70
- Fixed Casting blocks locking state not updated after world exit #92
- Fixed Casting recipe without molds that can be made no matter the mold item
- Fixed Casting recipes that allow mold items insertion during processing
- Fixed Casting recipes starting even if there not enough fluid amount
- Fixed console warnings when errors in json file for Casting & Foundry recipe type.
- Fixed Foundry Bassin issue with Faucet / Spoutput
- Fixed Mob Melting recipes that won't consume fluid ingredients in Crucible
- Fixed molten fluid buckets dispenser behavior

### Gameplay Changes
- Improved Faucet fluid transfer speed from 5mB/t to 10mB/t
- Crucible now drop items when destroyed
- Crucible fluids rendering have now smooth level transition
- Adjusted Sandpaper Belt recipe
- Adjusted Foundry Whisk craft recipe
- Adjusted Casting Table cooling sound
- Adjusted metals recipes such as Casting, Melting and BulkMelting
- Adjusted Steel blocks hardness, now require iron tools only
- Added compatibility with Necromium from Caverns&Chasms #107

### Art Changes
- Adjusted Industrial Crucible single block model

### API Changes
- Updated all "forge" id tags to "createmetallurgy" id
- Removed graphite mold type tags "forge:graphite_molds/ingot
- Changed "wolframite" items id to "tungsten"

name: Create Metallurgy 0.0.7-HF-1.20.1
changelog:
### Changes
- Added direct belt input behaviour to crucibles.
- Faucet now close automatically when opened manually.
- Re-added stress impact and speed requirements
- Fixed visual blockstate properties getter for the belt grinder.
- Fixed filtering slot rendering of the belt grinder.
- Merged the Glassed Foundry lid with the regular lid in one block.
- Faucet fluid streams now hurt entities (only #minecarft:lava or #forge:molten_materials).
- Molten fluids can no longer be a bottomless source (by default, can be changed in config).
- Fixed light bulbs rendering.
- Update to Create 6.0.6. (Fixed Fluid rendering)
- Added custom lang entry for Casting block locking mode.

That not contains any features, its just an hotfix for Create 6.0.6, some missing translations will be added in v0.0.8.

name: Create Metallurgy 0.0.7-C6-1.20.1
changelog:
### Changes
- Fixed inconsistency in casting blocks locking mode in default state.
- Faucet now only fills blocks that are open at the top (like drains).
- Crucible can now be filled with bucket like Fluid tanks (in creative mode).
- Fluid rendering of the faucet now adapts to hitboxes.
- Fixed fluids replacing crucible block.
- Compatiblity with Create 6.0
- Discontinued Minecraft 1.19.2

name: Create Metallurgy 0.0.7-C.5.1-1.20.1
changelog:
### Changes
- Update langs files (Chinese, Spanish, German).
- Added missing Gear/Rod mold recipes.
- Fixed recipes registrations warnings spam in console.
- Fixed Casting recipes goes away when unloading while processing.
- Change Wolframite tags to Tungsten tags. (Not display name changed).
- Added Dutch translation (By BramVerkuijlen).
- Fixed Alloying recipe won't start when multiple item input or any item ouput.
- Foundry recipes can now process continuously.
- Fixed Casting Recipes produces wrong output.
- Recipes can now be used in Assembly recipes (Grinding, ).
- Fixed melting netherite ingot wrong heat condition.
- Added Industrial Crucible & Foundry Unit (Texture made by Janko).
- Added Obdurium Alloy.
- Update Forge version (43.2.21 to 43.2.4 for 1.19.2) & (47.2.6 to 47.4.0 for 1.20.1) 
- Molten Fluids Buckets from compatibility no longer appear when no mod adds the corresponding metal.
- Removed Thermometer gauge on Foundry Lid.
- Update wolframite tags name to tungsten (Forge:dusts/wolframite -> Forge:dusts/tungsten).
- Molten Fluids have lava like effect (Lava pops sounds / particles and fire).
- Overhaul existing recipes for better compatibility.
- Reduced Foundry Melting sound volume and rate.
- Fixed Belt Grinder throwing items off the belt when full.
- Ajusted Foundry Basin texture.
- Fixed Close/Open sound inverted.
- Fixed Foundry Basin small spout can fill Fluid tank directly.
- Changed Creative Tab icon
- No more tadpole burning recipes :)
- Added Croatian localization (by Janko)

name: Create Metallurgy 0.0.6-1.20.1
changelog:
### Changes
- Fix Wolframite Ore loot table.
- Fix Coke / Steel blocks "Forge:storage_blocks/material" conflict.
- Foundry Basin can be fill by R-Clicking with Items on open Foundry Lids.
- Foundry Lids need to me Crouch to be open.
- Mold Consumed condition is now displayed in JEI recipes.
- Added console WARN when specified Mold condition without mold ingredient.
- Added German localization.
- Added Ponders to Create Ponder Index.
- Rewrite of Casting Basin/Table code (Casting recipe output can be a tag).
- Added Molten fluids (Netherite, Aluminum, lead, nickel, osmium, silver, tin).
- Change Tungsten wire craft now 1 ingot = 2 wires.
- Change Foundry Basin Spoutput behavior (R-Click on face with Wrench to enable it).
- Foundry Basin can no longer be used in Processing Recipes (Pressing, Mixing...).
- Fix Casting processing time speed up only if Casting Blocks are in air current at the recipe start.
- Changed Dirty Dusts tags ("forge:dirty_dusts/dirty_gold" to "forge:dirty_dusts/gold").
- Update Casting Basin / Table textures.
- Smelting recipe duration now appears up in JEI.
- Minerals dusts can no longer be smelt to make x1.33 (Ores processing WIP).
- Added ores compats (Aluminium, Lead, Nickel, Osmium, Silver, Tin).
- Added Alloys compats (Invar, Electrum, Bronze, Constantan, Void Steel).
- Update Create dependency from 0.5.1f to 0.5.1h (can be played with both).
- Added KubeJS compat.
